title: Iceland: Ring Road, Fire & Ice
summary: A paced loop of the Ring Road with room for the weather to change your plans — glacier lagoons, black-sand coastlines, and nights left open for the aurora.
highlights: The Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon by boat
Open evenings for the northern lights

itinerary.title: Arrive in Reykjavík
itinerary.description: Settle in, and a first look at the Golden Circle the next morning.

itinerary.title: The Golden Circle
itinerary.description: Geysir, Gullfoss, and Þingvellir National Park.

itinerary.title: South coast
itinerary.description: Black-sand beaches at Reynisfjara, then the Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon by boat.

itinerary.title: Glacier hiking
itinerary.description: A guided ice walk on Vatnajökull, Europe's largest glacier.

itinerary.title: East fjords
itinerary.description: A quieter, less-touristed stretch of coastline.

itinerary.title: Aurora night
itinerary.description: An evening left open, away from town light, weather permitting.

itinerary.title: Depart Reykjavík
itinerary.description: A final morning before your transfer to the airport.

included: 7 nights in guesthouses and small hotels along the route
A rental vehicle for the full loop
The glacier hike and glacier lagoon boat trip
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
excluded: Aurora sightings are weather-dependent and not guaranteed
